meta.name: convert-documents-to-markdown
meta.description: Convert an attached Word document, presentation, spreadsheet, OpenDocument file, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF into local Markdown. Use when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把办公文档转成Markdown格式
copy.tagline_en: Turn office documents into local Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need office documents as Markdown

howto.what: 当你在消息中附上本地文档（Word、PDF、CSV 等），Claude 会将其转换成 Markdown 文件，保存在容器本地，并告诉你输出位置；它不会把文档上传到外部服务。
howto.when: 当你提供本地附件路径，并要求读取或转换文档（如 Word、PDF、CSV 等）时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个 Word 文档转成 Markdown。
say.note: 转换后会在本地生成 .md 文件并告知路径。

say.text: 读取这个 CSV 并转为 Markdown。
say.note: 会以 CSV 格式处理 stdin 输出 Markdown。

say.text: 这个 PDF 能转成 Markdown 吗？
say.note: 若是文本型 PDF 则可转换，扫描版会提示不支持。

howto.what_en: When you attach a local document (Word, PDF, CSV, etc.), Claude will convert it into a Markdown file saved locally in the container and tell you the output path; no upload to external services.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a local attachment path and ask to read or convert a document such as Word, PDF, or CSV.

say_en.text: Convert this Word document to Markdown.
say_en.note: Output will be a local .md file with path shown.

say_en.text: Read this CSV and convert it to Markdown.
say_en.note: Processes CSV via stdin and writes Markdown.

say_en.text: Can this PDF be converted to Markdown?
say_en.note: Text-based PDFs work; scanned ones are unsupported.
